title: Collaborative Whiteboard
dek: Sceneledger, a shared online whiteboard I built: a React drawing app, a FastAPI server with accounts and live WebSocket sessions, and a PostgreSQL database. This page runs its drawing editor and every order in which two people's simultaneous edits can reach each screen.
summary: Sceneledger's editor, and every order two simultaneous recolours can reach each screen: applied as they arrive, screens can disagree; in sequence order, all agree.
